governance.attested_by: ercot145b gas-daily-shape session 2026-07-31 (matrix §5.1 item-4 five-ISO fuel-stack consistency lane; precommit docs/PRECOMMIT-ercot145-gas-daily-shape-2026-07-31.md pushed before the solve). BASIS FOR THE ATTESTATION, stated so it is auditable: (1) the DOF state is UNCHANGED from the attested ercot144 keeper — this arm is a single-delta replay of ercot144_perplant_arm adding ONE measured-commodity input (gas_daily_shape: the measured Henry Hub daily staircase divided by its own month mean — fuel.hubs.gas_daily_shape_factors, mean-preserving per month by construction, ZERO fitted parameters, re-derived only on source updates per rule 23); the ledger's n_entries 8 / n_residual 6 and every entry are byte-identical in kind to the ercot144 attestation basis. (2) Every structural lever traces to a measured/published input: the full ercot144 measured coal surface (ERCOT-137/144/140), CC committed = ERCOT-139 measured level, gas margin/cleared-share surfaces = measured SCED/DAM conduct, availability = measured DAM envelope, outages = historic CAMPD windows (exogenous), fuel = F923/EP measured + the measured HH daily shape this arm adds. (3) The remaining 6 residual entries are the rule-1-sanctioned offer-curve scope shared by every CALIBRATED keeper (offer_curve_by_group gas bands, smoothing shape) plus wefor pair / battery adder / merchant-CHP share, each carrying its open root-cause issue in this ledger (audit_keepers E8). (4) No lever in this run was fitted to a price residual and no output is pinned to actuals: the one input this run adds is a national commodity price series that predates and is independent of any ERCOT residual; the precommit §1c RECORDS that a fit gain was NOT predicted (ex-ante correlations nil/adverse/mild), so the observed C3a-2024/25 and C3b-2024 improvements were not tuning targets (rule 1). Guard outcomes are reported hour-level in the promotion note: two pre-registered guards tripped by ±1 threshold-straddling hour each (2023 C3c 47→46, the $203→$199.5 h6016 straddle on a real $2110 hour; 2024 spurious 2→3, a $207 model hour on the real Heather storm day h346 whose own actual is $141) — adjudicated by the owner's in-session standard (structural-integrity improvement outranks gate regression) as threshold noise, not the ERCOT-119 drain / tail-invention patterns the guards were designed against.
